title: Spherical Boltzmann machines: a solvable theory of learning and generation in energy-based models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09031v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Energy-based models (EBMs) are flexible generative architectures inspired by statistical physics, but their learning and generative properties remain poorly understood. Here, we analyze a solvable EBM in the high-dimensional limit: the spherical Boltzmann machine (SBM). Combining tools from random matrix theory and dynamical mean-field theory, we: derive and solve closed equations describing the training dynamics of the SBM in the high-dimensional limit; compute the asymptotic Bayesian evidence, which acts as a partition function in parameter space and encodes global properties of the trained model; and uncover cascades of phase transitions that occur both during training and as a function of hyperparameters, related to successive alignment and condensation of the top modes of the coupling matrix to the data. translated_title: 球形玻尔兹曼机：能量基模型中学习与生成的可解理论
translated_abstract: 能量基模型（EBMs）是受统计物理启发的灵活生成式架构，但其学习与生成特性至今仍缺乏深入理解。本文分析了高维极限下一个可求解的能量基模型：球形玻尔兹曼机（SBM）。结合随机矩阵理论与动力学平均场理论的工具，我们：（1）推导并求解了描述高维极限下SBM训练动力学的封闭方程组；（2）计算了渐近贝叶斯证据，它在参数空间中起到配分函数的作用，编码了训练后模型的全局性质；（3）揭示了在训练过程中以及随超参数变化而出现的级联相变，这些相变与耦合矩阵最高模态对数据的相继对齐与凝聚有关。我们还将这些相变与教师-学生场景中采样阶段的生成现象联系起来，包括：采样温度（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文借助随机矩阵理论与动力学平均场理论，建立了球形玻尔兹曼机在高维极限下的首个可解理论，推导出训练动力学的封闭方程、计算了作为参数空间配分函数的贝叶斯证据，并揭示了与耦合矩阵模态凝聚相关的级联相变及其对生成采样行为的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a solvable theory of spherical Boltzmann machines in the high-dimensional limit, deriving closed equations for training dynamics, computing the Bayesian evidence as a partition function in parameter space, and uncovering cascades of phase transitions tied to mode alignment and condensation that shape generative sampling behavior.
